name: github-copilot-for-data-professionals-demo-kit
description: Public-facing deck and Microsoft Fabric-oriented demos for GitHub Copilot with data engineers and scientists.

scripts.build: npm run build:notebooks && npm run build:deck
scripts.build:deck:windows: powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/download_product_icons.ps1; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/generate_deck_assets.ps1; npm run build:deck; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/apply_microsoft_template.ps1; powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/normalize_deck_layout.ps1
